# OSINT Evidence Engine

- Purpose: public non-personal evidence manifests, content digests and deterministic chain verification.
- Maturity: scaffolded; no collection, persistence, signatures or trusted timestamping.
- Start: README.md
- Contract: docs/EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md
- Threat model: docs/THREAT-MODEL.md
- Integration gates: docs/INTEGRATION-GATES.md
- Schemas: schemas/
- Library: osint_evidence/
- Tests: tests/
- Dependencies: osint-collection, audit-provenance, secure-supply-chain, emergency-control, compliance-governance (declared only).
- License: scoped mixed-license policy in LICENSE.md; file-level provenance and redistribution review remains required.
